object.description: Open DOC in a Document Editor with read-only mode off while a second instance of Mellon's services, standing in for the MCP server, works on the same repository. Change DOC-1 through the second instance, activate the Document Editor, reload, and edit DOC-1 in the Document Editor. Expected: the Document Editor's edit is written to disk; neither instance refuses to work on the repository.
